prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: single NPC dialogue portrait for a grounded low-fantasy pixel RPG.
Primary request: substantially REDRAW the identity in reference 1 as a new face-led portrait in the exact visual grammar of references 2-5. Reference 1 is the identity only; do NOT reproduce its chibi anatomy, giant eyes or full body. References 2-5 are approved style and crop examples: Mara v2, Iwo v1, Leiya v2 maxcoverage, Tore v1. Do not copy their faces.
Composition: vertical 74:100 canvas aspect; use the entire canvas as an enlarged logical 74x100 pixel grid. One head, just a VERY SHORT neck and a NARROW SLIVER OF COLLAR at bottom. Crown 2-3 logical pixels from top, sides almost touching silhouette bounds; face large and readable, chin near row 88-92, collar begins directly beneath jaw. No chest, shoulder bust, broad neckline, long neck or tiny floating head. Three-quarter view, facing slightly viewer left, with gaze mostly toward conversational partner. Keep complete crown/hair/hat and essential ears within canvas.
Style: hard-edged chunky pixel construction with broad connected warm skin planes, a strongly constructed adult nose bridge and cheekbones, nonuniform angular contour. Large grouped hair masses, no strand-by-strand lines. Use a restrained earthy 24-32 color appearance, one directional light, discrete flat shadow shapes. Small dark eyes with little muted warm-gray sclera, never brilliant white. Limited midtone transition, no airbrush, no smooth shading, no dither, no noise, no anti-alias look, no ornate ornament. Serious handmade game portrait, not cartoon, anime, glossy concept art, photo or oil paint.
Background: genuinely transparent outside silhouette. No text, grid, labels, decorations, frames or props. This is only the portrait; do not show hands or tools. Preserve identity age, hair structure and clothing colors while applying the latest card changes.

Subject lock: JOTIN / 乔彤, an adult WOMAN around thirty, practical typesetter, anxious about her livelihood and capable of dry self-mockery. Preserve reference 1's medium warm complexion, DARK BROWN practical up-tied bun toward the back/right with an asymmetric long front lock and a few large loose side locks, dark brows, muted blue work shirt and ink-gray protective outer smock. Keep adult elongated oval face with a narrower angular jaw than Loda, clearly drawn longish nose, slightly hollow tired cheeks. Do not give her glasses: the card says myopic but does not specify glasses. Show her myopia as slightly squinted, inward-focused eyes with little sclera; one inner eyebrow lifted with concern; a subtle crooked, CLOSED mouth conveys hesitation and self-deprecating intelligence, not a smile or sneer. She is a worker, not an elegant author or publisher. The ink-stained apron is worn reversed as a protective smock; at this tight portrait crop show only a narrow muted blue collar and ink-gray outer edge. No printed letters, no scarf or jewelry. Keep the bun compact, not a towering coiffure. Do not beautify or de-age.
